leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize an adjacency list to represent an undirected graph from given edges.
Implement a depth-first search (DFS) function to traverse connected nodes.
Construct a main function that iterates through all nodes to count disconnected components.
Apply the DFS algorithm to mark visited nodes and prevent redundant traversals.
Manipulate the adjacency list to correctly handle edge cases like single-node graphs.
Integrate the component counting logic into a complete, executable solution.
Render the final count of connected components for a given graph input.
